categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: (1) tire molds manufacturing and (2) related key materials such as 3D sintering sipes. The tire mold segment involves producing consumable molds essential for tire vulcanization processes, including tread, sidewall, and bead ring molds. The company also engages in manufacturing tire manufacturing equipment and related services, although these are minor compared to the mold business.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced casting, engraving, and multi-segment mold manufacturing technologies, including proprietary segmented mold manufacturing methods. It employs 3D CAD/CAM software for design and CNC machining for production. Additionally, it has developed industrial 3D metal printing technology for producing complex sintering sipes and invests in continuous R&D to improve mold materials, production efficiency, and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global tire manufacturers, including major tier-1 companies such as Kumho Tire, Pirelli, Yokohama, Continental, and Sumitomo. The company serves both original equipment (OE) tire markets for new vehicles and replacement equipment (RE) markets. Its products are critical consumables for tire production, targeting automotive and tire industries worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production and sales facilities in South Korea, China, Europe (Romania, Slovakia), Mexico, Russia, and Indonesia. Over 80% of its sales are to overseas tire manufacturers. It maintains a global marketing organization with dedicated teams for Europe, North America, and Asia, supporting direct sales and agent networks.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the tire manufacturing supply chain, specializing in producing tire molds and related consumables used by tire manufacturers. It is a key supplier to tire producers, providing essential tooling that directly affects tire performance and quality. It does not produce tires or raw materials but supports tire production through its molds and equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing global competitiveness through cost reduction, production efficiency, and expanding overseas manufacturing bases. R&D focuses on advanced mold manufacturing technologies such as segmented molds, 3D metal printing, and CAD/CAM software development. The company also explores new business areas like resource development (nickel mining) and electric vehicle battery-related components, although some diversification efforts like mask production and LED business have been discontinued.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of tire molds and related consumables to tire manufacturers. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery based on purchase orders from customers. It also earns minor revenue from tire manufacturing equipment and previously from mask production (now discontinued). The business model is product sales with a focus on long-term supply contracts with major tire companies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic tire mold market with advanced technology and a strong reputation. Major competitors include Korean Precision Works, Seyoung TMS, and Daekwang Enterprise, with some tire manufacturers producing molds in-house. The company competes globally with mold suppliers serving top-tier tire manufacturers and faces competition from Chinese mold makers with lower cost structures but less advanced technology.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated sales of approximately 67.1 billion KRW, showing a 15.3% increase from the previous year. Despite revenue growth, it recorded an operating loss of about 8.8 billion KRW and a net loss of 27.1 billion KRW. The company has total assets of around 106.5 billion KRW and equity of 52.3 billion KRW, with a debt ratio of approximately 103.7%. It is in a recovery phase focusing on profitability improvement and global expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its technological leadership in tire mold manufacturing, including proprietary segmented mold technology and advanced 3D printing capabilities. It offers high-quality molds that directly impact tire performance and durability, backed by long-term partnerships with major global tire manufacturers. Its global production footprint and ability to meet diverse customer specifications provide competitive advantages in responsiveness and cost efficiency.
